capabilities: put a pomodoro timer in the Obsidian window
track time using pomodoro work/break intervals
change timer durations in the settings
extras: README is minimal: no usage walkthrough or screenshots, and manual installation requires running npm build. The author thanks a contributor who suggested pomodoro support for obsidian-stopwatch-plugin, suggesting this plugin grew out of that one.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in timer, so users wanting the Pomodoro technique must leave the app or use a separate tool.

relations.evidence: santiyounger suggested me to add pomodoro technique support for obsidian-stopwatch-plugin

summary: Pomodoro timer that places a work/break interval timer inside the Obsidian window for time tracking.
